v20_benchmark.assumption: axion = 100% local DM at rho~0.3–0.45 GeV/cm^3

entries.name: CAST helioscope (2024 Xe)
entries.note: Solar axions; g<5.8e-11 for m_a≲0.02 eV. v20 g is ~2500× smaller.

entries.name: HB / globular-cluster stellar cooling
entries.citation: Ayala et al., PRL 113, 191302 (2014); CAST GC revisits 2024
entries.note: Order 6e-11 GeV^{-1}; does not touch QCD-axion strength at 150 µeV.

entries.name: SN1987A / supernova photon-coupling (schematic)
entries.citation: literature envelope used in MADMAX proto comparisons
entries.note: Much weaker than CAST/HB for this coupling; not a v20 killer.

entries.name: ORGAN Phase 1a
entries.citation: Quiskamp et al., Sci. Adv. 8, eabq3765 (2022)
entries.note: Excluded ALP-cogenesis near 63–67 µeV; does not cover 153.5 µeV.

entries.name: ORGAN Phase 1b
entries.note: Excluded ALP-cogenesis at 107–112 µeV (~26–27 GHz). v20 is ~37 GHz.

entries.name: MADMAX CB200 prototype
entries.note: First dielectric-haloscope axion search; ~77–80 µeV at g~2e-11. Not 153 µeV.

entries.name: QUAX-aγ (~43 µeV)
entries.note: Near-QCD sensitivity around 43 µeV / 10 GHz; far from 37 GHz.

entries.name: ADMX / HAYSTAC / CAPP (low-GHz cavities)
entries.citation: ADMX G2 / HAYSTAC / CAPP published runs (various)
entries.note: Mature QCD exclusions exist at few–tens of µeV, not at 150 µeV.

entries.name: ORGAN design envelope (future phases)
entries.status_at_v20: OPEN — not yet scanned at v20 depth
entries.note: 153.5 µeV sits inside design band; QCD-depth scan at 37 GHz not published.

entries.name: MADMAX full booster (design)
entries.status_at_v20: OPEN — not yet scanned at v20 depth
entries.note: Design aims post-inflationary ~100 µeV QCD axions; 37 GHz is on-roadmap.

entries.name: ALPHA / dielectric broadband (design)
entries.status_at_v20: OPEN — not yet scanned at v20 depth
entries.note: Later stages advertised around 80–200 µeV; no v20 exclusion yet.

classification.one_sentence: PHOTON BENCHMARK DOES NOT FAIL — no published direct bound excludes 153.5 µeV / 37 GHz at the quoted coupling. This does not clear the unresolved full fermion/flavour model.

soft_stresses_not_literature_exclusion: exact v_R=v_S flavour fit stressed vs natural ~1e14 GeV
continuous RG rejects old alpha_10(v_Phi)=1/40 reset
unit-coefficient loop numbers are diagnostics, not predictions

next_physical_step.action: Request / collaborate on a real 36.6–37.6 GHz scan
next_physical_step.what_would_fail_the_theory: A null result at g_agamma ≲ 2.3e-14 GeV^{-1} over 36.6–37.6 GHz kills the all-DM benchmark (not necessarily every diluted/subcomponent scenario).

verdict: PHOTON BENCHMARK DOES NOT FAIL — no published direct bound excludes 153.5 µeV / 37 GHz at the quoted coupling. This does not clear the unresolved full fermion/flavour model.
